name: Commerce Quick Node Clone
description: Quickly clone a commerce product with all of its fields and paragraphs. Supports Drupal 10, 11, and 12.

suggests.drupal/group: Optional: when the Group/gnode submodule is present, per-group create access is honored for the clone operation.
suggests.drupal/paragraphs: Optional: paragraph reference fields are deep-cloned so the copy owns its own paragraph entities.

project_description: Extension based on Quick Node Clone ( https://www.drupal.org/project/quick_node_clone ) that provides the possibility to clone Commerce product entities. Adds a per-bundle "Clone product" entity operation and a `Clone` local task on the product canonical page, plus a Views field plugin (commerce_quick_node_clone_link) for a clone link per row. Cloning opens a pre-filled product edit form for the duplicate (nothing is saved until the editor clicks Save); paragraph reference fields are deep-cloned, the clone is reassigned to the current user with fresh created/changed timestamps, and a configurable title prefix and publication-status behavior are applied. Per-product-type `clone <type> content` permissions gate the action, and Group/gnode create access is honored when that module is present. Requires the Commerce and Commerce Product modules.
